title: 4rd Sitting of third session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/4/3/2026).
Unfinished business: continuation of the debate on the Asset Recovery Bill (on property obtained through crime), submitted on behalf of the government by Fuvahmulah Central MP Ali Fazad.
Unfinished business: continuation of the debate on the Bill to amend the Criminal Procedure Act (Law No. 12/2016), submitted on behalf of the government by Funadhoo MP Mohamed Mamdooh.

Matters from committees: the Foreign Relations Committee's report on the President's request for Parliament's approval for the Maldives to join and implement the OIC "Makkah Al-Mukarramah Convention of the Member States of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation on Anti-Corruption Law Enforcement Cooperation".
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to continue debating the Asset Recovery Bill and the Criminal Procedure Act amendment, and to take up the Foreign Relations Committee's report on joining the OIC anti-corruption convention.
